brief.en: Fires jets of flame over a short distance
brief.zh: 短距离内喷射火焰攻击

description.en: Jack O' Lanterns spray fire down a lane, doing extensive burning damage over a short distance.
description.zh: 杰克南瓜向本行前方喷射火焰，对短距离内的敌人造成灼烧伤害。

chat.en: "Boo! Mwah-ha-ha-haaaaah," opines Jack O' Lantern. Oh, yes. Things and stuff are scheduled to be seriously spooky when he's around. Count on it.
chat.zh: “唔！！！呜哈哈哈！”杰克南瓜又开始吓大家。是的，当他在身边的时候，你就应该时刻做好被惊吓的准备了。好好期待一下吧。
